title: Adding categories from an industry preset
summary: Pick category types in bulk for jewelry, retail and other common trades, or add one at a time.

steps.text: Open {settings} and go to the Categories tab; your applied categories are listed under {yours}.
Expand {browse} to add categories one at a time, or apply a whole industry preset in a single step.
You can also ask the assistant to add categories from an industry preset, one at a time or a whole preset. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
